claims: C1 when the assistant sends a message to a tool, the tool response is appended as a new message with role=tool
C2 after that append, the assistant is invoked again

concepts.name: assistant_tool_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message the assistant sends to a tool, using the syntax documented for that tool

concepts.name: tool_response_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is tool, appended to the conversation after a tool call

concepts.name: appended_after
concepts.gloss: message M is appended to the conversation after message N

concepts.name: assistant_invoked_again
concepts.gloss: the assistant is invoked again after the tool response is appended

concepts.name: tool_role_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is tool, as defined by the message role definition

concepts.name: assistant_tool_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message the assistant sends to a tool, as defined by the tool definition

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task, as defined by the tool definition

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: R is a role definition for messages (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifying source and authority, as defined by the message role definition

ontology.gloss: M is the tool response appended after the assistant's tool message A
the assistant is invoked again after its tool message A receives a tool response
